This [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out]] [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], sometimes known as a '''scout blaster''' but commonly referred to as a '''scout trooper blaster pistol''', was a standard-issue weapon used by the [[Imperial Navy commando]]s and [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Clone scout trooper/Legends|Clone scout troopers]] of the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corps]] and [[Clone shadow trooper/Legends|Clone shadow troopers]] were also known to carry these weapons during the latter stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

This compact, one-handed [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] was fitted with a side-mounted targeting scope and phase amplifier, and featured a miniature gas cell on the rear. The weapon had a short-range [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]]. Scout troopers commonly carried these weapons in a boot holster of their [[Scout trooper armor/Legends|armor]]. Because scout troopers wore padded gloves, the pistol had a pressure-sensitive grip rather than a trigger. The trooper was able to hold the grip with two gloved fingers through the enlarged finger guard.
